Gentle Mates is an French esport organization. On April 13th, 2023, Gentle Mates was formed. The team previously existed as SBG but rebranded following the Gentle Mates brand launch. [1]

The organization also competes in Call of Duty in the Call of Duty League, VALORANT, Rocket League, League of Legends, Fortnite, Age of Empires, Teamfight Tactics
